question: Regarding the mailing list about duo users, provide the number of students in this list, and the number of departments and schools associated with these students.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE duo_mailing_list_members AS
WITH target_list AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key, moira_list_name
  FROM beaver."moira_list"
  WHERE UPPER(TRIM(moira_list_key)) = 'CAT-DUO-USERS'
     OR LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name)) = 'cat-duo-users'
)
SELECT 
  tl.moira_list_name AS list_name,
  LOWER(TRIM(mld.moira_list_member)) AS member_email
FROM target_list tl
JOIN beaver."moira_list_detail" mld
  ON mld.moira_list_key = tl.moira_list_key
WHERE mld.moira_list_member IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH duo_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(dm.member_email) AS email
  FROM duo_mailing_list_members dm
  WHERE LOWER(dm.list_name) = 'cat-duo-users'
), stud AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(sd.email_address) AS email,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sd.department), ''), NULL) AS dept_code,
         NULLIF(TRIM(sd.department_name), '') AS dept_name
  FROM student_directory sd
  WHERE sd.email_address IS NOT NULL
), duo_stud AS (
  SELECT s.email, s.dept_code, s.dept_name
  FROM duo_students d
  JOIN stud s ON s.email = d.email
), dept_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department_code AS dept_code,
         department_name AS dept_name_canon,
         school_code, school_name
  FROM student_department_dim
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM duo_stud) AS num_students,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(ds.dept_code, dm.dept_code))
     FROM duo_stud ds
     LEFT JOIN dept_map dm ON dm.dept_code = ds.dept_code) AS num_departments,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.school_name)
     FROM duo_stud ds
     LEFT JOIN dept_map dm ON dm.dept_code = ds.dept_code
     WHERE dm.school_name IS NOT NULL) AS num_schools;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH target_list AS (
  SELECT TRIM(moira_list_key) AS list_key
  FROM duo_list
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name)) = 'cat-duo-users'
), members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.moira_list_member AS raw_member,
         d.moira_list_member_mit_id AS mit_id
  FROM duo_list_members d
  JOIN target_list t ON t.list_key = d.moira_list_key
), member_emails AS (
  -- moira_list_member may be an email or a username; extract likely email tokens
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(raw_member)) AS token
  FROM members
  WHERE raw_member IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(raw_member) <> ''
), stud AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email_address)) AS email,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(department), ''), NULL) AS dept_code,
         NULLIF(TRIM(department_name), '') AS dept_name
  FROM student_directory
  WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL
), duo_stud AS (
  -- Match either on exact email token or on username@mit.edu heuristic
  SELECT s.email, s.dept_code, s.dept_name
  FROM stud s
  JOIN member_emails me
    ON s.email = me.token
       OR s.email = me.token || '@mit.edu'
), dept_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department_code AS dept_code,
         department_name AS dept_name_canon,
         school_code, school_name
  FROM student_department_dim
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS num_students,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(ds.dept_code, dm.dept_code)) AS num_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dm.school_name) FILTER (WHERE dm.school_name IS NOT NULL) AS num_schools
FROM duo_stud ds
LEFT JOIN dept_map dm ON dm.dept_code = ds.dept_code;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH target_list AS (

  FROM beaver.mit_student_directory

  FROM student_dir sd
  JOIN members m ON m.mit_id = sd.mit_id_from_email
), dept_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(department_code) AS dept_code,

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH target_list AS (
  SELECT TRIM(moira_list_key) AS list_key
  FROM beaver.moira_list
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name)) = 'cat-duo-users'
), members_raw AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(d.moira_list_member)) AS token,
         CAST(d.moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
  FROM beaver.moira_list_detail d
  JOIN target_list t ON t.list_key = d.moira_list_key
  WHERE (d.moira_list_member IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.moira_list_member) <> '')
     OR d.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL
), students_dir AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(email_address)) AS email,
         TRIM(department) AS dept_code,
         TRIM(department_name) AS dept_name
  FROM beaver.mit_student_directory
  WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL
), students_emp AS (
  -- Some students appear in employee directories; use as auxiliary to recover MIT IDs and emails
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
         LOWER(TRIM(email_address)) AS email
  FROM beaver.employee_directory
  WHERE email_address IS NOT NULL AND mit_id IS NOT NULL
), members_email_match AS (
  -- Match by exact email or username@mit.edu against student directory
  SELECT sd.email, sd.dept_code, sd.dept_name
  FROM students_dir sd
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT token AS email_candidate
    FROM members_raw
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT token || '@mit.edu' AS email_candidate
    FROM members_raw
  ) m ON sd.email = m.email_candidate
), members_id_match AS (
  -- Match via MIT ID by bridging members -> employee_directory (email) -> student directory
  SELECT DISTINCT sd.email, sd.dept_code, sd.dept_name
  FROM members_raw mr
  JOIN students_emp se ON se.mit_id = mr.mit_id
  JOIN students_dir sd ON sd.email = se.email
), duo_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT email, dept_code, dept_name FROM members_email_match
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT email, dept_code, dept_name FROM members_id_match
), dept_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(department_code) AS dept_code,
         TRIM(department_name) AS dept_name_canon,
         TRIM(school_name) AS school_name
  FROM beaver.student_department
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS num_students,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(ds.dept_code,''), dm.dept_code)) AS num_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dm.school_name) FILTER (WHERE dm.school_name IS NOT NULL AND dm.school_name <> '') AS num_schools
FROM duo_students ds
LEFT JOIN dept_map dm ON dm.dept_code = ds.dept_code;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 0 AS num_students, 0 AS num_departments, 0 AS num_schools;
